##50% is due at the time of booking. The remaining balance is due at the time of the charter.

##Departing Location

Boston Sailing Tours departure location is at Courthouse Docks, Located Across From Marcelino's Seaport - 2 Northern Ave, Boston, MA 02210. All trips will depart from this location. Paid public parking is available.
[MAP] (https://maps.app.goo.gl/gHTdWAB4SDhYSsPQ6)

##Duration

6 Hours

##About

A Unique Experience: We are the unique sailing charter company in Boston that offers an exploration tour of Grape, Lovells, and Bumpkin Islands, only accessible by private boat. You can disembark and discover the islands while the boat and captain wait for you.

What is there? An amazing diversity of wildlife can be observed. You will be able to experience secluded beaches with spectacular views of the other islands and the ocean. You will also find remains of a military installation dating from the Revolutionary War to World War II and old trails to hike around. The islands receive very few visitors every year. During your tour, you are likely to be the only one.

##What to Bring

CONSIDER TO BRING
Sailors should dress for safety, comfort, and weather. In spring and fall, dress in layers and bring a jacket or sweatshirt; it can be cooler at sea than on land.

In summer, bring a hat, sunglasses, and sunscreen. 

For safety and comfort, soft-soled shoes like boat shoes or sneakers are the preferred footwear aboard the Francesca. You will be asked to go barefoot for safety reasons if you wear hard-soled shoes or high heels on board.

WHAT NOT TO BRING
You’re also welcome to bring aboard your own food and drinks. We recommend keeping food to snacks and easy-to-eat items like sandwiches.  Plan as if you are going on a picnic as we do not have a formal table on board. Drinks can include alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages. 

Per Federal regulation no marijuana or marijuana-containing products no illicit drugs

##Food, Drinks, Music

• You’re welcome to bring your favorite food, drinks, and music.
• We recommend easy-to-eat items and canned drinks. 
• We do not have a formal table in the cockpit
• We have complimentary water and sodas on board

[FULL GUEST INFORMATION](https://www.bostonsailtours.com/full-day-grand-tour)
